_comment: SFX manifest for AI generation. Each key is the output filename (without extension). 'prompt' is the text description for AudioGen. 'duration' is seconds (1-10 recommended). 'category' organizes output into subdirectories.

sword_slash.prompt: sharp sword slash swoosh through air

sword_hit.prompt: metal sword hitting metal armor clang impact

player_hurt.prompt: short impact thud with pain grunt

monster_death.prompt: monster defeated dissolving poof magical burst

door_open.prompt: heavy wooden door creaking open slowly

door_locked.prompt: door handle rattling locked door thud

chest_open.prompt: treasure chest lid opening wooden creak with sparkle

key_pickup.prompt: small metallic key pickup jingle chime

item_pickup.prompt: positive short chime item collect sound effect

footstep_grass.prompt: single footstep on grass soft step

footstep_stone.prompt: single footstep on stone floor hard step

water_splash.prompt: small water splash stepping into shallow water

portal_enter.prompt: magical portal whoosh teleport energy swirl

boss_roar.prompt: large monster boss roar deep intimidating growl

npc_chat_open.prompt: soft pop bubble appearing UI notification
